design_identity.theme: Dark Mode Default with Light Mode Toggle Support
design_identity.tone: Empowering, Data-Dense, High-Precision, Futuristic yet Accessible
design_identity.target_audience: Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, Designers & Tech Professionals seeking targeted career progression

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

visual_enhancers.card_hover: transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-indigo-500/50 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-500/10

key_features_and_layouts.auth_flow: Split-screen modern layout. Left: Ambient glowing animated career target nodes. Right: Glassmorphic form with email/password login, register, and quick test persona presets.
key_features_and_layouts.wizard_flow: 4-Step Interactive Skill Engine Wizard: 1. Target Role Selection (Curated roles + custom title input), 2. Experience & Resume Extractor (Textarea paste with instant live token count & extract button), 3. Skill Radar & Extraction Verification (Editable tags grouped by category), 4. Gap Analysis Calculation Trigger.
key_features_and_layouts.dashboard_overview: Top: High level Readiness Score Gauge (e.g. 74% Match), Stats cards (Strong Count, Partial Count, Gap Count, Est. Upskill Weeks). Middle: Radar Chart comparing Current vs Target Role Skill Requirements + 3 Categorized Buckets (Strong, Partial, Gap). Bottom: Weekly Roadmap & Milestone Progression Tracker.
key_features_and_layouts.roadmap_tracker: Chronological milestone timeline. Each week card features resource links (Articles, Courses, Projects), checkbox completion toggles, skill tags, and practical action items.
key_features_and_layouts.progress_dashboard: Interactive skill verification checklist, skill proficiency updater, overall readiness score updates in real-time as tasks are marked completed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust, full-featured Skill Gap Engine matching all problem statement requirements: Auth, Profile Setup with Resume Paste, Target Role Selection, AI Skill Extraction, Gap Analysis Engine (Strong/Partial/Gap buckets), Results Visualization (Recharts Radar + Progress charts), Personalized Roadmap with milestones & curated resources, and Progress Dashboard with completion tracking.
Ensure all interactive components and key content items include explicit `data-testid` attributes.
Provide pre-loaded demo personas (e.g. Frontend Engineer -> Senior Fullstack Architect, Data Analyst -> Machine Learning Engineer) for 1-click testing.
Use standard Recharts components (ResponsiveContainer, RadarChart, PolarGrid, PolarAngleAxis, Radar, BarChart, PieChart) for data visualizations.
Use Sonner for toasts, Lucide React icons for tactical UI indicators, and Shadcn UI primitives for modal/dialogs/tabs/selects/tooltips.
Never rely on transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, tooltips, or floating headers. Always apply background surfaces and blurs.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="login-submit-button", data-testid="resume-text-input", data-testid="skill-bucket-strong").
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.theme_execution: Default to slate/indigo dark theme with toggle option for light mode.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.animation: Framer motion for smooth step wizard transitions, radar chart animations, and roadmap completion micro-interactions.
